content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not count a cited verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it treats C4 as pressed against a dropped limb, leaving no live link.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"'counts as an unanswered witness' / 'counts toward a broken link': (1) any mention of a pressed verse triggers the quotation requirement; (2) only an actual count of a verse as an unanswered witness to a broken link triggers it.","why":"The judge text does not count C4 as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link; it says the pressed limb was dropped, so K-G4's quotation requirement is not triggered."}
